name: VIP B
source: Cineplex booking-site seat map screenshot, Wed Nov 25 2026, 7:30 PM showing (VIP 19+)
notes: The booking site does not show the hall number, so this room is named by the order of the screenshots. Seat numbers are not shown on the map: they count from the left of each row and may not match the numbers on a ticket. Row A has wheelchair spaces (left as gaps) with a companion seat next to the first one. AA is a front row; the map leaves a one-row aisle between AA and A, which the 3D room does not show. Seats the map does not draw are left as gaps: they may be blocked for this showing rather than missing from the room. Entrance is not known, so the default is used. Dimensions are estimates. Rows A to F have many seats that the map does not draw, including most of row D and the right end of rows A and F.
